randomEnemyDeck.runtimeRule: main card Type=1, MonsterID>0, not deprecated by Name, Quality=0, Race<=11; then monster Type=1, HP<=7, Attack<=1; Phyle match is attempted per fixed hero and falls back to the same stat-filtered pool when empty

modelCoverage.mappingSemantics: v5 exact scoped monsterId first; fallback only by exact scoped recovered modelId; no name/equipment guesses. V4 baseline retained separately.
modelCoverage.sameModelArtworkCaveat: Runtime v5 resolves same-model IDs through models map; sharing does not rewrite cards, names, effects, source config or ownership. Other model IDs still use recovered resources.

boundaries.denominator: 127 deduplicated recovered model IDs in direct Chapter 1 references union the current level-1 generated enemy-deck pool.
boundaries.secondarySummons: BattleKernel can create additional units through effect, death, resurrection, trap, per-turn, hatch and terrain flows. Those paths depend on drawn cards and board state and were not exhaustively runtime-sampled here.
boundaries.rewardBoundary: firstClearRewardCards are scene-trigger card prizes. Ordinary loot tables are outside this denominator.

summonDependencies.scope: Static dependency extraction from the enabled direct Chapter 1 monsters and the 129 level-1 enemy-deck cards. Root effects are monster ability1..ability5; TypeID 15 composites are expanded recursively. No exhaustive battle-state execution is claimed.
summonDependencies.denominatorNote: These dependencies are downstream runtime products. They do not change the 127-model denominator, which remains direct Chapter 1 references union the initial random enemy-deck pool.

concreteMonsterTargets.runtimeRule: applyStaticEffects stores param1 as skeletonMonster; removeDead summons that monster at the death square unless resurrection is blocked.
Same TypeID 85 death path as effect 8501. Monster 1380 resolves to the same recovered bone-heap model as 1169.
applyStaticEffects stores param1 as turnSummonMonster; processUnitTurn summons monster 9038 in a nearby legal square.

The source dependency is concrete, but current activeEffectRows expands TypeID 15 composites only. TypeID 50 applies child 11701 statically without retaining it as an active turn effect, so resolveTurnEffects does not execute the TypeID 117 summon from this path.

transformAndRebirth.runtimeRule: On death, a 33 percent roll restores the same unit once in its current square. This adds no new model dependency.

transformAndRebirth.sourceDeclaredTarget: Skeleton, without a concrete monster ID in the effect row.
transformAndRebirth.runtimeRule: TypeID 86 sets transformAfterTurns=1. Current processUnitTurn selects the first different monster with the same Phyle; for all three Phyle-2 bone heaps, current catalog order resolves monster 1001 Zombie Guard. It changes monsterId and stats but does not clear noMove/noAttack or apply monster 1001 effects, so this is not a faithful Skeleton recombination.

dependencyBlockers.rule: Effect 7702 sets piercing and an eraseKills flag on the attacker. Current BattleKernel does not consume eraseKills when that attacker kills a unit, so the described suppression of Reanimate, return-to-hand and TypeID 85 bone-heap summons is not currently enforced by this effect.

unresolvedDynamicFamilies: The reachable TypeID 86 bone-heap effect has no concrete target ID; current same-Phyle fallback yields monster 1001 and retains immobility flags.
The reachable TypeID 50 to TypeID 117 Blaze Adept summon declares four concrete targets but is not reached by current active-effect traversal.

No enabled root/composite closure in this bounded set reaches gateway TypeID 113, graveyard summons TypeID 155/409, kill-revive TypeID 196, self/random transform TypeID 166, trap TypeID 170, random-turn TypeID 405, or incubation marker 7703. Their generic BattleKernel branches are therefore not added as Chapter 1 dependencies here.
evidence: cocos-client/assets/resources/recovered/catalog.json: monster ability rows, effect rows and stable monsterModels
backend/game/content.mjs: commonCards and enemyDeck level-1 filter

productionStatus: 10 additional models produced and native Cocos mixed action QA; direct model source coverage12/12, random/direct union19/127. Summon dependencies remain separately classified.
